# speckit nexttest

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

The ranked next-test feed (feature 087, FR-021): which test to write or run right now — FRs without first scenario, then first failing scenario run, then orphan scenarios — each carrying the exact resolving command

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit nexttest [OPTIONS]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.
